training.scope: Every raw training row, including rows excluded by some model builders.

normalization.roman: Same conservative lowercase/long-vowel/chh/sh/v/w fold as engine normalization.
normalization.native: Unicode NFC, trim, remove ZWJ/ZWNJ. Any matching accepted variant rejects the entire case.

novelty: Both normalized Roman input and every accepted native word must be absent from TRAIN, validation, old public test, seed lexicon and previous test inputs/references/candidate exposures. Subword units and roots are learned and may overlap.
selection: Predeclared quotas; SHA-256 order within category; at most one case per lexical/verb family; no fresh engine or Google output consulted.
